scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,seller,pay,food,admin,warm -c blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan,gray "npm --prefix shop-ecommerce run dev" "npm --prefix shop-sell run dev" "npm --prefix shop-pay run dev" "npm --prefix shop-food run dev" "npm --prefix admin-portal run dev" "bash scripts/warmup.sh"
